_note: Framework defaults for the rate guard (system/hooks/rate_guard.mjs). A server listed here is rate-limited: the guard counts every call after it ran and blocks a call that is over a cap or too soon. A server that is not listed is never touched. To add a server later, add a block here; no code changes. Your own overrides live in config/limits.json (lowering a number is always allowed; raising one needs accept_risk). Day caps reset at local midnight, week caps on Monday at 00:00.

linkedin.name: LinkedIn
linkedin._note: LinkedIn publishes no limits, so every number is a cautious starting point, not a LinkedIn rule. The figures follow LeadLoft, 'LinkedIn Limits 2026' (Zack Olivas, 2026-06-15, https://www.leadloft.com/blog/linkedin-limits) for a Premium account, all [Claim: LeadLoft]: invites 'around 20-30 per day' and 'up to 200 per week' on Premium; messages '150 per week' on paid accounts; profile views 'up to 2,000 profiles per day' on Premium with the advice to 'stay under half'. The invite weekly_cap is 150, not 200, because invites sent by hand from the app never reach the ledger but still count against LinkedIn's weekly limit. weekday_cap keeps invites to Monday to Thursday. Search: LinkedIn's monthly search quota is about 300 and resets on the 1st [Unverified: framework author, from a web search], so the daily search cap is 14 (about 300 over 21 weekdays). The other categories are the framework author's own cautious guesses [Speculation]; the invite min_gap_seconds was lowered from 90 to 20 by the author. The author used these numbers on a Premium account for an active outreach campaign, so they are generous for most people: on a free account, lower them in config/limits.json. Warning rule (the author's): a checkpoint, CAPTCHA or warning stops all calls and halves every cap; a second one switches the server to draft-only. throttle_days, pause_hours and draft_only_window_days are Alterbrain's own choices [Assumption]. Tool names are those of mcp-server-linkedin 4.26.2 (identical to 4.24.4); a tool not listed counts as 'other'.
